Requirement: System shall provide browser/mobile access to internal GUI sessions through self-hosted control plane.
System shall support LAN, VPN-first, and DMZ-first deployment profiles.
System shall log session start/join/leave/terminate and control events.
System shall include an Agent Harness Runtime for run lifecycle, tools, policy, approvals, evidence, replay, and token budgets.
System shall support scoped memory for org/team/project/repo/ticket/user/agent/run scopes.
Memory entries shall be inspectable, exportable, versioned, redactable, and auditable.
System shall build bounded context packs for agent runs with token/cost budgets.
System shall support frontier BYOK, company-hosted, laptop-local, and perception model profiles.
System shall provide setup profiles for LM Studio, Ollama, Continue, and OpenAI-compatible local endpoints.
System shall broker outbound API/credential access through an Agent Egress Gateway.
Raw long-lived credentials shall not be exposed to prompts, memories, tool outputs, or agent environments.
Tickets shall act as executable work contracts for agent runs and evidence packets.
Every completed agent run shall produce an evidence packet.
System shall model communication and resource permissions as capability edges.
System shall support a code intelligence service for graph/context packs.
System shall support future multimodal perception profiles without depending on one specific model.
System shall support optional AI buddy/avatar UX as a non-core, post-MVP feature.
System shall track P2 Multimodal/Proactive Desktop as a future research/prototype lane separate from P0/P1 delivery commitments.
